caption: The drawing depicts a rectangular tray with upturned edges, all rendered in shades of grey, blue, and subtle hints of yellow. Centered on the tray is an elaborately shaped, fluted candlestick holder made of reflective metal, supporting a tall, unlit cylindrical candle that is light yellow in color with a visible black wick at the top. To the left of the candlestick is a conical metal object, possibly a candle snuffer, also rendered in metallic grey. On the right side of the tray is a scissor-like candle wick trimmer or snuffer, with a flat compartment for collecting trimmed wick pieces and a circular handle, all illustrated in similar metallic tones. The background of the drawing is plain and uncolored, focusing attention on the four objects arranged on the tray.
title: Silver Candlestick with Two Snuffers
